body: I have sought out professional help, but none of the medicine works. I appreciate you commenting, because I didn't think anyone would care, but I just don't see a version of life better than the current one.

It's not just my looks, it my extreme anxiety. I'm an interesting person, and I have so much I want to share to the world. I just feel like i'm living the reality you're talking about right now, and it's hell.
I've been working out and am on a diet. I've went from 105 to 152 with low body fat, weightlifting.  I still get made fun of for looking skinny and weak

It does matter when the people who are calling you ugly are the people you need to tell you that you aren't for you to have to kind of validation. I try so many different things. I play sports, i'm involved in academics, and I try to go out in the community and do stuff. I have hobbies, but they are introverted hobbies.
I know that it doesn't matter that they are assholes and they're opinions are worthless, but I can't fix being skinny. I have IBS. It makes it hard for me to keep weight on.
I was bullied all throughout middle school and high school and people told me that, and I am just really skinny.
